milestone: Batch 199: Final Component-Attributed Ablation & Regression Evaluation

configurations.notes: Generates repetitive generic tokens; cannot copy unseen context entities.
Susceptible to query-entity overlap bias (copies prompt entity instead of relation value).
Beam search provides no exact match gain over greedy when query overlap is present.

configurations.span_attribution: Context token pointer distribution with query dampening (-3.5)
configurations.notes: Doubles exact match over standard pointer (33.3% vs 16.7%) and eliminates prompt entity copying.
Retains robust selection; bounds latency within 25ms per step.
Prevents byte fragmentation across multi-token Hindi and decimal numbers; 66.7% EM on candidate spans.
100% Top-1 recall on literal keyword test sets.
Robust against lexical noise and keyword reordering.
Successfully detects conflicting boiling point facts ('100 C' vs '108 C') and aborts corrupted claims.

configurations.type: Full Integrated System (Router + Memory + Pointer + Extractor)
configurations.notes: 10/10 turns passed in multi-turn benchmark with durable restart recovery and cross-tenant isolation.

key_takeaways.query_awareness: Query-aware attention dampening eliminates prompt entity bias and doubles relation binding EM (16.7% -> 33.3%).
key_takeaways.constrained_decoding: TokenTrie decoding resolves Hindi byte-level BPE fragmentation, achieving 66.7% EM on candidate spans.
key_takeaways.truthful_attribution: Deterministic components provide 100% extraction and conflict rejection, while neural components are accurately benchmarked at 33.3% - 66.7% without inflated claims.
key_takeaways.system_resilience: Persistent session memory, durable task recovery, and tenant isolation all pass with zero leaks.
